name_zh: 拉宾/以色列/奥斯陆/诺贝尔/和平/遇刺/辛贝特/佩雷斯
description_zh: 伊扎克·拉宾 (1922-1995) 是以色列政治家，曾任总理。他领导以色列与巴勒斯坦权力机构签署奥斯陆协议，推动和平进程，赢得诺贝尔和平奖，但后来遇刺身亡。他的安全机构辛贝特在以色列安全中发挥重要作用，与佩雷斯等政治家合作。
description_en: Yitzhak Rabin (1922-1995) was an Israeli politician who served as Prime Minister. He led Israel in signing the Oslo Accords with the Palestinian Authority, promoting peace process, winning the Nobel Peace Prize, but was later assassinated. His security agency Shin Bet played an important role in Israel security, cooperating with politicians like Peres.
reason_zh: 核心思维：M536(奥斯陆协议/和平进程/遇刺/辛贝特/拉宾遗产)、1(战略预判)、20(博弈论)、40(三衙分兵/军政分离)、67(战略敏捷)。拉宾体现了战略预判和博弈论精神，通过奥斯陆协议实现和平进程，通过遇刺和安全机构建设确保国家安全，通过三衙分兵实现军政分离。
reason_en: Core thinking modes: M536(Oslo Agreement/Pacific Process/Assassination/Shin Bet/Rabin Heritage)、1(Strategic Foresight)、20(Game Theory)、40(Three-gate Separation/Military-Civilian Separation)、67(Strategic Agility)。Rabin embodies strategic foresight and game theory spirit through Oslo Agreement realizing peace process, assassination and security agency construction ensuring national security, Three-gate Separation achieving military-civilian separation.
steps_zh: 第1步：战略预判法——制定和平大计：制定奥斯陆协议和和平进程计划
第2步：博弈论法——和平博弈：通过外交谈判实现和平
第3步：三衙分兵法——军政分离：通过安全机构建设和政治改革实现国家建设
第4步：战略敏捷法——灵活和平：通过外交手段实现国家建设
steps_en: Step 1: Strategic Foresight - Formulate peace plan: Formulate Oslo Agreement and peace process plan
Step 2: Game Theory - Peace game: Achieve peace through diplomatic negotiation
Step 3: Three-gate Separation - Military-civilian separation: Realize national construction through security agency construction and political reform
Step 4: Strategic Agility - Flexible peace: Achieve national construction through diplomatic means
case_zh: 1922 出生；1974-1977 任总理；1995 遇刺身亡。奥斯陆协议/和平进程/遇刺/辛贝特范式永存。
case_en: 1922 birth; Prime Minister 1974-1977; assassinated 1995. Oslo Agreement/Pacific Process/Assassination/Shin Bet paradigm endures.
